title: VooPoo Vmate i2 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Vmate i2 Pod Kit is the ultimate compact pod device for vapers who want a hassle-free, long-lasting and satisfying vape experience. Available in multiple vibrant colours, the Voopoo Vmate i2 is the perfect choice for vapers seeking a sleek, reliable, ergonomic, and flavour-packed vape kit in a compact, easy to pocket form factor. A skid-proof design adds a tactile texture to the chassis for a safe, comfortable grip at all times. With its 1500mAh built-in battery, the Vmate i2 ensures you can enjoy vaping throughout the day without worrying about constant recharges. When the time to recharge arrives, the USB Type-C port allows for quick and convenient charging, so you’ll be ready to vape again in no time. The Vmate i2 Pod Kit also boasts a smart LED light bar that runs the length of the device and changes colour to indicate battery life, so you always know when it’s time to recharge. With six safety protections, the Vmate i2 offers protections from overcharge, low battery, short circuits and more. This versatile device is compatible with Voopoo’s Vmate family of fixed-coil pods, each offering a 2ml e-liquid capacity and long-lasting coil technology that can provide up to 30 days of use per pod. Featuring Voopoo's ITO coil and Fresnel lens technology, the pods deliver rich flavour and dense vapour, making them perfect for both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles depending upon your chosen pod’s coil resistance. You can easily adjust the airflow for a more personalised experience, switching between tighter or more open draws with ease. The top-side fill system ensures fast, mess-free refills, and the device's durable build makes it ideal for everyday use, whether you’re at home or on the go. We recommend using 50/50 or Nic Salts E-Liquid with this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
